_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Neutral F&G/VIX/funding keep the tape in-range; only a confirmed break of the coil moves the rung, and forced direction has poor base-rate payoff here.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicitly HOLD toward Complacency; narrative is flow-descriptive only and does not contradict or confirm a directional phase shift
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC holds recent range, F&G stays 45-55, and CVD/ETF flows do not make a fresh leg
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks under 40 with accelerating downside and pinned flows/CVD (slip to Denial/Panic side), or multi-day ETF inflow reversal plus 30d momentum reclaim (lift toward Disbelief)
